facts.formats: Open Data Hub formats and APIs
facts.scope_guard: Point and polygon distribution supports spatial screening but does not replace the List entry, designation extent interpretation or HMLR title.
Heritage-at-risk status describes condition and vulnerability and is not planning permission, ownership or a guaranteed development outcome.
Annual files are time-specific snapshots; removals and additions must retain their year and are not current planning decisions.

scope_guards: NHLE is the official protected-heritage register but a register entry is not planning permission or title ownership.
National search totals are coverage context and are not candidate-specific designations.
Listed-building points and polygons are screening geometry and must be reconciled to the exact List entry.
A heritage point is not a legal extent, HMLR parcel or development red-line.
Heritage at Risk is condition and vulnerability evidence and not automatic refusal, vacancy or redevelopment readiness.
Annual HAR additions and removals retain their year; historic snapshots are not silently made current.
Open Data Hub availability and update dates do not prove an executed candidate overlay.
No score or promotion is written without exact List entry, site relation, current planning case and title evidence.
